notes.subject: לעולם היא לי
notes.rationale: Lit. 'it is to me forever' — KJV 'they are ever with me' vs YLT 'before me to the age'; kept 'stap wantaim mi oltaim'.

notes.subject: היא
notes.rationale: Feminine singular pronoun 'she/it' points to Torah (v.97); plural 'ol i' follows the plural 'komand' reading.

translation: Ol komand bilong yu ol i givim save long mi, moa long ol birua bilong mi, bilong wanem, ol i stap wantaim mi oltaim.
